title: Usage Insights API: top routes endpoint (pagination, filters, query cost limits)
author: Chloe Martin
body:
Title: Usage Insights API: top routes endpoint (pagination, filters, query cost limits)

Summary
This adds the first public API endpoint to power the Console “Top cost drivers by route” view. Endpoint returns a ranked list of routes with cost + performance aggregates, supports filters required by the Console, implements cursor-based pagination, and includes explicit query cost guardrails to prevent expensive scans.

Context / Why
Console needs a single endpoint that can: (1) list routes ordered by spend for a given org/project/time window, (2) support the filter model from the design spec (env/region/deployment mode/model), and (3) remain stable under load without customers accidentally issuing “scan the world” queries. This PR is scoped to the list view only; route detail (model breakdown + deltas) is in follow-up PRs.

API
- GET /v1/usage/insights/routes
- Returns: routes ranked by total_cost_usd (desc) with cost token breakdown + p50/p95 latency + error_rate.
- Cursor pagination: limit + cursor (opaque base64) with deterministic ordering.

Request params (high level)
- time_range: start, end (ISO-8601)
- scope: org_id required, project_id optional (if omitted, aggregates across org projects the caller has access to)
- filters: environment, region, deployment_mode, model (optional), route_prefix (optional)
- pagination: limit (default 50, max 200), cursor

Response (high level)
- items: [{ route, model (optional depending on aggregation source), total_cost_usd, input_tokens, output_tokens, cached_tokens, request_count, error_rate, p50_latency_ms, p95_latency_ms, window_start, window_end }]
- next_cursor
- meta: { truncated, data_freshness_lag_seconds }

Implementation details
- Uses pre-aggregated hourly/daily rollups (usage_insights_route_hourly_mv / usage_insights_route_daily_mv).
- Chooses hourly vs daily based on requested time span:
  - <= 72h: hourly
  - > 72h: daily
- Stable ordering: ORDER BY total_cost_usd DESC, route ASC; cursor encodes (last_total_cost_usd, last_route).
- Filter parsing is centralized in InsightsQueryParser to keep the route list / route detail endpoints consistent.
- Query cost guardrails:
  - Max time window: 31 days (400 if exceeded)
  - Max lookback from “now”: 90 days (400 if exceeded; aligns with retention for aggregates)
  - Enforces limit <= 200
  - Rejects unbounded route_prefix patterns (must be >= 3 chars if provided)
  - Defensive circuit-breaker on estimated partitions scanned (based on day/hour buckets); returns 422 with actionable message
- Adds response caching layer (in-process) keyed by normalized query for 30s to reduce duplicate Console refresh load (feature-flagged, default on for console user-agent).
- Adds basic metrics:
  - insights_api_top_routes_requests_total{status}
  - insights_api_top_routes_query_ms (p50/p95)
  - insights_api_top_routes_cache_hit_total

RBAC / Auth
- Uses existing org/project scoping middleware.
- If project_id is not provided, results are limited to projects the caller can access (no cross-project leakage).
- Audit logging is NOT included here (export-only per security spec) but we do include request_id propagation for later correlation.

Testing
- Unit tests for filter parsing (including invalid time windows and unsupported enums).
- Pagination determinism tests (same results across pages when data is unchanged).
- Integration test against seeded aggregates verifying ordering and filter application.
- Load-ish test (local) verifying query stays under our 250ms budget on representative dataset.

Docs
- Adds OpenAPI entries + example requests/responses.

Notes / Follow-ups
- Route detail endpoint (model breakdown + deltas) is tracked in ENG-8424.
- Export job API will reuse the parser + guardrails; additional limits (row caps / file size) in ENG-8425.

---

Review conversation (abridged)
Jada Williams (requested changes): Cursor should include a tiebreaker beyond route name because cost ties can be common at low spend. Also please ensure cursor encoding is stable and versioned.
Chloe Martin (author): Added (total_cost_usd, route) ordering and a cursor_version=1 prefix in the encoded payload. Updated tests to cover equal-cost pages.

Mei Lin: Are we guaranteed to hit the MV and not the raw metering tables? Can we add an explicit allowlist?
Chloe Martin: Yes; InsightsStore only exposes query methods backed by the MV views. Added a regression test that fails if the query plan references metering_events.

Allison Grant: Please emit a metric when we reject due to query cost. Also, default limits should be conservative.
Chloe Martin: Added insights_api_top_routes_rejected_total{reason} and set default limit=50.

Kaitlyn Nguyen: For org-wide queries without project_id, confirm we’re not leaking routes across projects the user lacks access to.
Chloe Martin: Added join to authorized_projects temp table generated by middleware; integration test added for a user with partial access.
